description: Source code for the FPDF library version 1.53, providing classes and methods to generate PDF documents programmatically including page formatting, text, images, fonts, and resource management.

classes.name: FPDF
classes.description: Main class for creating and managing PDF documents, including adding pages, setting fonts, writing text, images, and handling PDF structure.

methods.name: AddPage
methods.description: Starts a new page with optional orientation.

methods.name: SetMargins
methods.description: Sets left, top, and right margins of the page.

methods.name: SetAutoPageBreak
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic page breaks with a specified margin.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to be overridden for custom page headers.

methods.name: Footer
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to be overridden for custom page footers.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs the PDF document to browser, file, or as a string.
